literal: Desire having suffered, to those who grieved, protection except the palmyra stem, there is no strength.
translation: For those who have suffered and grieved in love, there is no strong refuge other than riding the palmyra stem.
modern: காதல் துன்பத்தால் வருந்தியவர்களுக்கு மடல் ஏறுவதைத் தவிர வேறு உறுதியான பாதுகாப்பு இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet captures the desperation of unfulfilled love. The phrase 'காமம் உழந்து வருந்தினார்க்கு' describes those who have struggled and suffered deeply from intense romantic desire. In their extreme distress, their only remaining source of strength and refuge ('ஏமம்', 'வலி') is 'மடல்'. This refers to the ancient Tamil practice where a desperate lover publicly rides a rough horse made of jagged palmyra stems to win their beloved or perish. The speaker asserts that when love brings unbearable pain, this drastic public declaration is the only strong recourse left.
